import openpyxl, os
from datetime import datetime
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
ws = wb['ورقة1']
# read data A2:E
rows=[]
for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1):
    d=ws.cell(r,1).value
    if d is None: continue
    rows.append((d, ws.cell(r,2).value, ws.cell(r,3).value, ws.cell(r,4).value, ws.cell(r,5).value))
# last date per brand
last={}
for d,b,bt,o,q in rows:
    if b not in last or d>last[b][0]:
        last[b]=(d,bt,o)
# sum qty for entries on last date per brand
from collections import OrderedDict
order=[]
for d,b,bt,o,q in rows:
    if b not in order:
        order.append(b)
res=[]
for b in order:
    ld=last[b][0]
    s=sum(q for d,bb,bt,o,q in rows if bb==b and d==ld)
    res.append((ld,b,last[b][1],last[b][2],s))
# write starting H2
for i,(d,b,bt,o,q) in enumerate(res):
    r=2+i
    ws.cell(r,8).value=d
    ws.cell(r,9).value=b
    ws.cell(r,10).value=bt
    ws.cell(r,11).value=o
    ws.cell(r,12).value=q
wb.save(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
print(res)
